text:
Alex (Sales): Heads up — Acme POC started hitting 429s around 10:12am UTC; they say it spikes when many agents run embeddings job. Anyone able to triage? Log snippet attached.

Tess (Acme): We're running a batch embed job with ~50 concurrent requests; client retries on 429 and that creates backpressure.

Priya (Eng): Can you paste full request headers and which route/model? Might be per-route cap or token accounting.

Jon (SRE): I'm pulling metrics for tenant acme-123 — I see a sharp spike at 2026-03-20T10:12Z on route /v1/embeddings. Pulling logs now.

Alex (Sales): Model=open-embed-v1, route=/v1/embeddings, sample time=2026-03-20T10:12:34Z. Snippet:
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
X-RateLimit-Limit: 30
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
X-RateLimit-Reset: 2026-03-20T10:13:04Z
{"error":"rate_limited","detail":"per-route burst exceeded"}
```

Priya (Eng): Default per-route cap for embeddings is 30 rps, burst bucket_size 30, refill_rate 1 token/s. If they fire 50 concurrent requests it's expected to get 429s. Two mitigation paths: reduce concurrency on client or temporarily increase per-tenant per-route cap.

Tess (Acme): Any quick config change we can do while we adjust client? This POC is live for a demo.

Jon (SRE): I can apply a temporary override. Current settings: bucket_size=30, refill=1/s. Suggest bump to 120 rps for 1 hour. Will monitor. Any billing notes?

Alex (Sales): Finance OK to apply POC credit for short window — confirm hours.

Priya (Eng): Also recommend client-level throttle config. Example:
```
{
  "concurrency": 10,
  "backoff": { "base_ms": 200, "max_ms": 2000 }
}
```
That'll smooth spikes and reduce retries.

Jon (SRE): Applied override at 2026-03-20T10:25:00Z — acme-123 /v1/embeddings cap=120 rps until 2026-03-21T10:25:00Z. Monitoring: error rate dropped to <0.5% within 2 mins.

Tess (Acme): Confirmed — retries stopped, demo looks good. Thank you! :thumbsup: 

Alex (Sales): Action items: Priya to add per-tenant burst guidance to POC checklist; Jon to propose safe auto-bump policy; I'll log the POC credit and update the deal notes.

Priya (Eng): I'll open a PR with client example and docs. cc @deploy-bot for review.

deploy-bot: Created PR #6723 — "poc: add per-tenant burst guidance"

Jon (SRE): Closing this swarm. If they need sustained high throughput we'll discuss dedicated/reserved capacity. Marking resolved.
